explanation: The eraser was attached to the end of a pencil. A picked up the pencil by its eraser end and used the pencil tip to write a message on the blank paper.
A picked up the eraser because it was attached to a pencil. A used the pencil to write the message on the blank sheet.
The eraser was on a mechanical pencil. A removed and picked up the eraser so the pencil's lead could be advanced, then used the pencil to write the message on the blank sheet.
A's mechanical pencil was out of lead. A removed and picked up the eraser at its end to open the pencil, inserted a new lead, advanced it, and wrote the message on the blank paper.
